items.class: S6a follow-on pilot design duties: deadlines unverified against stored data
items.rule: Duty whose sentence starts 'Such pilot projects shall' and follows a sentence that states a period: deadline should be an offset from that period, not on_effective_date. Check stored records against the 3 sample instances (S6a rule exists in extract_duties; the whole-database count is not yet run).
items.note: model none was stamped on_effective_date by triggered_to_setup; S6a now covers none; 3 stored

items.class: Imperative list items with no granting lead-in, flagged
items.rule: Items beginning 'To <verb>' or a bare imperative under a lead-in that grants nothing (no shall/may/authorized). Flag as judgment (needs_judgment) and list the 35 in a mechanical_flags file; decide per item whether the lead-in's actor holds a duty or power.
items.note: no-modal actor lead-in rule, cap 40; 0 stored dropped items match, rest keep the flag

items.class: Appointment items ignoring the 90-day clause (narrow)
items.rule: Appointment duties whose sentence carries 'within ninety days' but stored with deadline_kind none or on_effective_date. Narrow regex on quote: appoint* plus 'ninety days|90 days'; set an offset of 90 days.
items.note: next-sentence period rule added; 0 stored match the shape

items.class: sub-items of one duty split into records
items.rule: report content items under 'shall include:' and criteria under 'shall determine whether:' are parts of the parent duty, not records; gate with lead-in detection

dissolution_transfer_stored_as_duty
condition_on_other_record
duplicate_prepare_submit_report

items.note: Oct 21: V1B kept off; the 5 criteria items stay as records (kept), gold 09/11 vs 10/12-15 inconsistent

items.class: keeps taken without review
items.rule: 2015-A7996-05 was judged definition text by the Oct 19 verification and should drop (own act clause or definition gate); 2015-S5949-96 unreviewed

items.class: one-time installation duties with no stated deadline left none
items.rule: a one-time setup duty (install, erect, post) with no stated deadline keeps on_effective_date per the Council rule; check why triggered_to_setup skipped these
items.note: signage or installation joins the triggered_to_setup types; 4 stored (all 2017-S5570, backlog id was mislabeled)

items.class: stated 'July first in the year next succeeding' stored as on_effective_date
items.rule: a stated date relative to the effective year is fixed_date at that date

items.class: parallel sections with identical text merged by excluded_merged_duplicate
items.rule: upper bound; sample 20 merged drops blind before any rule change
items.note: merge only on same citation and act section; 300 of 307 stored merged drops come back (dry run); unvalidated by re-extraction

items.class: additive re-ask merge duplicates reworded records
items.rule: merge_reask_answer must match re-ask records to originals by overlapping located spans in the law text (and by citation), not by quote Jaccard; only truly new spans are added; test on 2011-A2411 and 2011-S2704; score on gold before enabling
notes: Oct 30 2026: 7 of 100 re-asks skipped because replace mode needs the whole law re-emitted (77-177 KB omnibus laws with 26-101 records: 2011-A55, 2009-S8314, 2011-S6732, 2013-S6358, 2011-S6255, 2013-S2605, 2013-S6357); a span-based additive merge would let a narrow re-ask answer only the listed sentences

items.class: effective date forms unparsed
items.rule: add both forms to effective_date.py; reversion needs chapter_index

items.class: one-time duties with deadline none (Council rule says on_effective_date)
items.rule: sample 25 blind first; then widen SETUP_TYPES or the triggered_to_setup rule
items.note: operation_of_law drop + none->on_effective_date for typed one-time duties without trigger

items.class: list items under a mandatory passive lead-in dropped as designation_no_actor
items.rule: sample 25 blind first; most are content sub-items by policy
items.note: imperative / To-verb designation_no_actor rescue with exceptions

items.class: historical date-bounded reprinted sentence split into one record per listed actor
items.rule: a sentence whose only new matter is outside it and whose date bound is before the law's year is reprinted text; check why reprinted_existing_text did not fire
